faq.question: What is Promogo Ghana?
faq.answer: Promogo Ghana LTD is your product promotion platform, open and available everywhere in Accra. We provide e-commerce services with fast delivery across Ghana.

faq.question: What products do you sell?
faq.answer: We sell a wide range of products including Electronics, Phones & Gadgets, Sports & Outdoor, Fashion, Vehicles and machinery, Home appliances, Health & Beauty, Agriculture & Food, and more. We have 9+ products available.

faq.question: What is your return policy?
faq.answer: We offer a 7 Days Return Policy for all products. We guarantee 100% authentic products and safe payment processing.

faq.question: Do you deliver across Ghana?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide fast delivery all across the country. We are based in Accra but serve customers throughout Ghana.

faq.question: What brands do you carry?
faq.answer: We carry top brands including China Mall, Tecno, Nasco, Hisense, Innoventia and many more.

faq.question: How can I contact you?
faq.answer: You can contact us at +233596782334 or email us at contact@promogo.ga. We are located in Accra.
